entities.summary: Eric Jean Baptiste was a Haitian politician and entrepreneur who served as the leader of the Rally of Progressive National Democrats from 16 August 2018 until his death on 28 October 2022. He was a candidate in the 2015 presidential election, representing the Mouvement Action Socialiste (MAS) party.
